notes: 1. The attachemnt of subsidiary 8.1.1 is a simple knot. 2. It seems that the knot on pendant 70 is modern. 3. Between pendants 110 and 111 there are two cords sewn to the frame. These cords have the following characteristics: Cord 1: length: 37.0 cm. knots: 5L (33.0/S). color: W:KB The end closest to the primary cord has a tie of 3.0 cm. and a final knot. Cord 2: length: 34.0 cm. knots: 6L (3.5/S), 1S(29.5/Z) It seems that the second knot is a modern addition. color: KB-W. It is probable that this cord is a continuation of pendant 113. the distance between the groups 15 and 16 is very small.
